description: This C# source file is the main program for a database migration runner. It orchestrates applying versioned SQL migrations to a PostgreSQL database without using Docker, including environment variable loading, command-line argument parsing, migration discovery, and execution. It also handles applying migrations in order, logging progress, and maintaining a custom migration history table.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main entry point class for the migration runner, containing static methods for execution and environment setup.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsRequest
classes.description: Record type encapsulating parameters needed to run migrations, such as environment variables, directory info, and dry-run flag.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsResult
classes.description: Record type representing the outcome of migration application, including counts of applied and skipped migrations.

classes.name: MigrationFile
classes.description: Represents a migration SQL file, including version, description, and file info.

classes.name: MigrationDiscovery
classes.description: Static class responsible for discovering and parsing migration files in a directory.

classes.name: MigrationHistory
classes.description: Static class managing migration history record reading and writing to the PostgreSQL database.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: Helper static class that converts DATABASE_URL format into an Npgsql-compatible connection string.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main asynchronous method that launches the migration process.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if present.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an ApplyMigrationsRequest object.

methods.name: ResolveMigrationsPath
methods.description: Determines the migrations directory based on input or default paths.

methods.name: PrintHelp
methods.description: Outputs help information about how to use the migration runner.

methods.name: NormalizeEnvValue
methods.description: Cleans up environment variable values by trimming and removing quotes.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes the migration process, applying pending migrations and recording history.

methods.name: ResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Chooses and constructs the appropriate connection string from environment variables.

methods.name: EnsureHistoryTableAsync
methods.description: Creates the migration history table if it does not exist.

methods.name: ExecuteSqlAsync
methods.description: Executes a batch of SQL commands within a transaction.
